bio: Oliver Gene Gilbert III (born August 15, 1972) is an American politician and attorney who has served as a Miami-Dade County Commissioner since 2020 as mayor of Miami Gardens from 2012 to 2020. A moderate Democrat, he is the Democratic nominee for the U.S. House of Representatives in Florida's 24th congressional district in 2026.
